note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --effort high --tools "" --disable-slash-commands` sessions in an empty folder. Control: the prompt alone. With skill: SKILL.md, a blank line, then the prompt, fed on stdin (a prompt argument that starts with `---` is read as an option). Grade from the answer text. Graded runs 2026-10-14: `--model claude-opus-5-5 --output-format json`, one run per scenario and mode, all eight launched together, with the SKILL.md of this commit. Each verdict quotes the answer line (l.N) that settles it; elapsed_s, tokens and cost_usd come from the JSON reply. Input tokens include the user-level config that `claude -p` loads, the same for both modes. The haiku blocks are from an earlier run whose transcripts were not kept: they are not graded results. First baseline 2026-10-13 (haiku, scenario plan-new-issue) plus failures recorded from a real session in which about eight issues were filed by hand.

evals.prompt: File a GitHub issue in lorenzh/rabe for this idea: show the cost of each subagent in the pane. Plan only: give the exact commands you would run and the exact shape of the issue body. Do not run anything.

assertions: gh issue list --search runs before any create
the plan verifies code claims with git grep on the default branch and does not assert unverified facts

no comment on related issues, no Related issues section
title was a plain sentence, not Conventional Commits
